title: NHKマイルCの後に・宙吊り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon finishes the NHK Mile C.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I propose that she follow the established race schedule and aim for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She consents but suggests that I not get my hopes up as she leaves the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still uncertain as to whether or not she'll run in the Kikuka Sho, we begin our preparations all the same.
